verdicts.reason: A uses a proper left-to-right banner flow: the phone fills most of the height, the headline and subcopy sit together, and the CTA is on the right. Its only flaws are minor: the CTA pill's ends look slightly distorted, and the phone sits fairly close to the left edge. B shrinks the phone to a small icon and leaves large empty bands above and below. Its subcopy also floats far below the headline, so the two no longer read as one group, and the whole composition looks under-scaled and loose.
